My best recollection is that roughly 50% of Mexican respondents who used these services reported paying a bribe in the prior year, based on the 2017 Global Corruption Barometer for Latin America. I can't verify this here and I don't have a reliable exact figure, so treat it as an estimate. The Transparency International GCB 2017 Latin America report would confirm or correct it.

CONFIDENCE: 35
